submittedText: Your documents and ₹100 application fee are under review.
pageIntro: Incomplete or incorrect information may lead to rejection. Your progress is saved automatically.
savedOnDevice: Saved on this device until draft creation
courseStepText: Enter your name surname-first, exactly as printed on the SSC marksheet.
identityStepText: These details must match the applicant's official documents.
familyStepText: Provide both parents' contact details and the present and permanent addresses.
permanentSameAsPresent: Permanent address is the same as present address
educationStepText: Select the board and enter marks or grades exactly as shown on the marksheet.
scienceConfirm: I confirm Science was one of my SSC subjects.
subjectGradeHint: Enter the grade printed for each subject. Example: English | A2.
subjectMarksHint: Enter one subject per row. Example: English | 100 | 72.
subjectMaxHint: Up to 6 subjects can be added.
documentsStepText: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP; maximum 4 MB per file. Four physical photographs may be requested at admission.
documentsAiNote: Each upload is scanned by AI to check it's the right document type, legible, and appears genuine. If a file is flagged, you'll see the reason on that document's card and can re-upload it — our admissions team also reviews every document manually.
declarationStepText: Review the summary, accept the declaration, and pay the ₹100 application fee.
declarationText: I declare that the information and documents supplied are genuine. I have read the course details, fee structure, institute rules and disciplinary requirements, and understand that incorrect, misleading or forged information may result in rejection or discontinuation.
feeQrMissing: Payment QR is not configured. Contact admissions.
errUploadEveryDocument: Upload every required document before continuing.
errAcceptDeclarationAndFee: Accept the declaration and upload the ₹100 application-fee payment screenshot.
errPleaseWaitDraft: Please wait while your draft is saved.
errSaveContactFirst: Save your contact details before uploading files.
errFileTooLarge: Each file must be 4 MB or smaller.
errUploadTimeout: Uploading {label} timed out. Please try again.
validSelectCourseAndName: Select a course and enter the student's full name.
validStudentPhone: Enter a valid student phone number.
validStudentEmail: Enter a valid student email address.
validDob: Enter a valid date of birth.
validDobPast: Date of birth must be a valid past date.
validParentMobiles: Enter valid mobile numbers for both parents.
validParentAge: {label} age must be between 18 and 120 years.
validPresentAddress: Complete the present address, including city, district, and state.
validPresentPin: Enter a valid six-digit present-address PIN code.
validPermanentAddress: Complete the permanent address with a valid six-digit PIN code.
validSscBoardSchoolYear: Enter a valid SSC board, school, and passing year.
validSscPercentage: SSC percentage must be greater than 0 and no more than 100.
validSscMaxMarks: SSC maximum marks must be greater than 0.
validSscMarksExceed: SSC marks obtained cannot be greater than maximum marks.
validSscPercentageCalc: SSC percentage must be {calculated}% based on the entered marks.
validScienceConfirm: Confirm that Science was one of the SSC subjects.
validHscBoardSchoolYear: Enter a valid HSC board, school or college, and passing year.
validHscPercentage: HSC percentage must be greater than 0 and no more than 100.
validHscMaxMarks: HSC maximum marks must be greater than 0.
validHscMarksExceed: HSC marks obtained cannot be greater than maximum marks.
validHscPercentageCalc: HSC percentage must be {calculated}% based on the entered marks.
validSubjectsMax6: {level} can contain a maximum of 6 subjects.
validSubjectName: Enter the subject name in {level} row {n}.
validSubjectExceed: Marks obtained for {subject} cannot be greater than maximum marks.
